subject: Post-call: procurement & security next steps (PO vs card, SOC 2 / DPA)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — procurement + security gating

Thanks again for taking time today, Jordan — great conversation. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our call so procurement and security can proceed: 

Summary:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference (hosted + dedicated options) for a pilot focused on customer-facing summarization.
- Procurement preference: team indicated PO-first (preferred) but may use card for POC spend if needed.
- Marketplace: you mentioned interest in AWS Marketplace onboarding but procurement needs clarity on commercial flow if we use Marketplace (invoice cadence, PO handling).
- Security gating: Acme IT security requested SOC 2 Type II, an executed DPA, and a completed security questionnaire before vendor approval.

Agreed immediate next steps:
1) I'll share our SOC 2 report (redacted) and the standard Redwood DPA for their review (attached).
2) Dev Patel (cc) will be available to coordinate commercial terms / any contract redlines.
3) Jordan: please confirm whether procurement wants vendor onboarding via AWS Marketplace (if yes, we’ll engage Marketplace team) or direct Redwood contract. Also, confirm whether a PO will be raised or if card/payment is acceptable for the initial POC.
4) Acme security: if you can send over the security questionnaire we’ll fill it out and provide any evidence requested.

Attachments: SOC2-Report-2026-TypeII.pdf, Redwood-DPA-v1.2.docx

If helpful I can set a short follow-up to align procurement + security owners — propose Thursday 3/25 at 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — procurement + security gating

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

- Purchase order: Procurement prefers PO for any production or pilot that will run more than a month — we can do a single PO to cover POC if needed. Card payment is OK for small one-off evaluation spend but not ideal for ongoing or committed pilots.
- Marketplace: We like the idea of AWS Marketplace for centralized billing, but procurement still often requires a vendor-side contract for legal/compliance review. If Redwood is on Marketplace, we still need the DPA and SOC 2 uploaded to Marketplace or provided directly.
- Timeline: If we move forward, procurement will need vendor onboarding documents and a W-9. Our standard vendor onboarding timeline is ~3–5 weeks once paperwork is in.

I’m looping IT security (security@acme.com) on the SOC 2 and questionnaire items. Jordan

Hi Marissa / Jordan,

Quick note from Acme InfoSec — thanks for the SOC 2 and the DPA draft. To move forward we need the following: 

1) SOC 2 Type II (latest 12-month period) — redacted copy is fine.
2) Executed DPA or DPA with our redlines tracked — highlight any non-negotiable data residency or subprocessors.
3) Completed security questionnaire (attached spreadsheet/template) — we typically need network architecture, encryption-at-rest/in-transit details, MFA for ops, incident response SLAs, and logging/retention settings.
4) For pilot deployments that will process customer PII, can Redwood support a VPC/private deployment or a dedicated instance? If yes, please include a short note on deployment options and timeline.

If you can provide items 1–3 and a statement on 4, we can move to the vendor review queue. Typical security review time after documentation is ~7–10 business days.

Thanks,
Sam Riley
InfoSec Manager
Acme Corp
security@acme.com

Hi Jordan / Sam — thanks for the clear asks. Bringing Dev and our legal/ops folks into this thread. Answers and next steps below: 

SOC 2 / DPA:
- Attached: SOC2-Report-2026-TypeII.pdf (redacted), Redwood-DPA-v1.2.docx (standard). Dev, happy to take any redlines — we can usually agree on a narrow set of changes.

Security questionnaire & deployment options:
- We’ll complete your questionnaire — can you confirm the template (please attach if not already)?
- Deployment: Redwood supports both hosted (multi-tenant) and Dedicated/Private deployments (VPC option). For a Dedicated/VPC pilot we can provision in ~3–4 weeks after contract and environment details; for hosted trial we can get you started in a couple of days.

Commercial path / marketplace:
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace and we can onboard you there. If Acme prefers Marketplace billing, we’ll share the onboarding doc (attached: Redwood-AWS-Marketplace-Onboarding.pdf) and coordinate with Alex Reed (cc). Note: Marketplace billing still requires DPA + SOC 2 to be accessible to Acme and procurement.
- PO vs Card: For pilot runs longer than a month procurement PO is preferred. For initial sandbox testing we can accept card. Once you confirm procurement preference we’ll draft an SOW or order form to match.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Dev will coordinate any DPA redlines and pushback to expedite legal review (dev_patel@redwoodinference.com).
2) Jordan / Procurement to confirm PO vs card and whether to use AWS Marketplace.
3) Sam / Acme InfoSec: please share the security questionnaire template if you haven’t already; we’ll return a completed version and any architecture diagrams.
4) I’ll schedule a 30-min onboarding/ops call for next week to walk through deployment options if helpful.

Attachments: SOC2-Report-2026-TypeII.pdf, Redwood-DPA-v1.2.docx, Redwood-AWS-Marketplace-Onboarding.pdf
